🎥🎬: Crocodile Dundee 

Rugged Australian bushman Mick “Crocodile” Dundee becomes an international sensation after an American journalist travels to the Outback to tell his incredible story. When she invites Mick to New York City, the fearless adventurer finds himself navigating a world far stranger to him than the Australian wilderness.

Using his quick wit, survival skills, and laid-back charm, Mick tackles city life in hilarious and unconventional ways, often leaving locals amazed by his confidence and resourcefulness. Along the way, he forms a heartfelt romance while proving that courage and kindness matter more than where you come from.

Blending comedy, adventure, and romance, Crocodile Dundee became one of the biggest international hits of the 1980s, turning its lovable hero into a pop culture icon.

source_details.synopsis: Michael J. "Crocodile" Dundee (also called Mick), played by Paul Hogan, is a fictional protagonist in the Crocodile Dundee film series consisting of Crocodile Dundee, Crocodile Dundee II, and Crocodile Dundee in Los Angeles. The character is a crocodile hunter, hence the nickname and is modeled on Rod Ansell.
